facts.fact: Eswatini's Central Statistical Office launched the 2025 CRVS Annual Report, releasing birth registration completeness of 61% and death registration completeness of 62% for 2025.

SWZ.note: The article does not say the figures are drawn from registration records.
The document does not mention authentication.
The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system; integration is only a stated priority.

facts.fact: Eswatini's Central Statistical Office says birth registration completeness reached 61% in 2025 (8.3% in 2016), a national rate not tied to a digital system.

SWZ.note: The document gives civil registration completeness, not the share of people holding a national ID.
The document names no ID number given at birth.
The document does not mention who runs the ID system.
The document does not mention registers keyed on the ID number.
The document does not describe a national ID system.
Digitalisation of records is named only as a priority for 2027-2036; no digital entry at offices is stated.
